title: Adjective Agreement 2: Soft Stems
description: A small but high-frequency family of Russian adjectives takes a parallel set of soft endings: -ий for masculine, -яя for feminine, -ее for neuter, -ие for plural. Words today: синий, последний, домашний, утренний, ранний.
descriptionRussian: Прилагательные с мягкой основой и четыре окончания: -ий (мужской), -яя (женский), -ее (средний), -ие (множественное число). Слова: синий, последний, домашний, утренний, ранний.
intro: The second family is much smaller than the first, and it is not a second system so much as the same system spoken softly. Notice which words end up here: a great many of them are about time and position, the everyday furniture of describing where and when. Learning them together is easier than meeting them one at a time later and wondering why they refuse the endings you expected.
rules: Soft-stem adjectives have four nominative endings: -ий (m sg), -яя (f sg), -ее (n sg), -ие (pl, any gender). The dictionary form ends in -ний (синий, последний, домашний, утренний, ранний).
The slot pattern matches Lesson 1's hard-stem set vowel for vowel: hard -ый ↔ soft -ий, hard -ая ↔ soft -яя, hard -ое ↔ soft -ее, hard -ые ↔ soft -ие.
The plural ending -ие is the same for masculine, feminine, and neuter nouns, just like hard -ые in Lesson 1.

Identifying a soft-stem adjective: the masculine singular form ends in -ний. If a dictionary lists the adjective as ending in -ный, it is hard-stem and uses Lesson 1's endings (умный, важный, скучный).
examples: Это синий шарф. (This is a blue scarf.) Шарф is masculine singular, so the soft-stem adjective takes -ий: синий.
Это последняя песня. (This is the last song.) Песня is feminine singular (-я), so the soft-stem adjective takes -яя: последняя.
У Маши домашнее задание. (Masha has homework.) Задание is neuter singular (-е), so the soft-stem adjective takes -ее: домашнее.
В саду ранние цветы. (There are early flowers in the garden.) Цветы is plural, so the soft-stem adjective takes -ие: ранние.
Утренний поезд опаздывает. (The morning train is late.) Поезд is masculine singular, so the soft-stem adjective takes -ий: утренний.
Это синее озеро. (This is a blue lake.) Озеро is neuter singular (-о), so the soft-stem adjective takes -ее: синее. The soft -ее is the parallel of the hard -ое.

items.hint: Warm-up from Lesson 1. Озеро is neuter singular: which hard-stem ending fits?
items.explanation: Recall from Lesson 1: hard-stem neuter singular takes -ое. Озеро ends in -о (neuter), so the answer is красивое. The same -ое will return in today's lesson as the soft-stem parallel -ее.

items.hint: Шарф is masculine singular. The soft-stem masculine ending is the parallel of hard -ый.
items.explanation: Шарф is masculine singular (consonant ending). The soft-stem masculine ending is -ий, so синий. Compare the hard-stem parallel красивый шарф from Lesson 1: same slot, hard vowel -ый instead of soft -ий.

items.hint: Песня ends in -я. The soft-stem feminine ending pairs with hard -ая.
items.explanation: Песня is feminine singular (-я ending). The soft-stem feminine ending is -яя: последняя. The same -яя ending lands on every soft-stem adjective modifying a feminine noun: ранняя весна, утренняя пробежка.

items.hint: Задание ends in -е. Which gender does that signal, and which soft ending matches?
items.explanation: Задание is neuter singular (-е ending). The soft-stem neuter ending is -ее: домашнее. The phrase 'домашнее задание' is the standard Russian word for 'homework' and is built from this exact agreement.

items.promptEnglish: There are early flowers in the garden.
items.hint: Цветы is plural. The soft-stem plural ending pairs with hard -ые.
items.explanation: Цветы is plural. The soft-stem plural ending is -ие, the same form for masculine, feminine, and neuter nouns: ранние. Compare the hard-stem parallel красивые цветы from Lesson 1: same slot, hard vowel -ые instead of soft -ие.

items.hint: Поезд is masculine singular. Recall the soft-stem masculine ending from earlier in this lesson.
items.explanation: Поезд is masculine singular. The soft-stem masculine ending is -ий: утренний. Same slot as синий шарф from Q1.2; same -ний family of adjectives.

blanks: Это _____ озеро. (This is a blue lake.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Озеро is neuter singular (-о ending). The soft-stem neuter ending is -ее: синее. The same agreement logic as the hard-stem -ое from Lesson 1.

errorCorrection.sentence: У меня домашний работа сегодня вечером.
errorCorrection.explanation: Работа is feminine (-а ending), so the soft-stem adjective takes the feminine -яя: домашняя. Soft stems use -яя where hard stems use -ая.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: This is a blue sea in the photo.
errorCorrection.explanation: Море is neuter (-е ending), so the soft-stem adjective takes the neuter -ее: синее. Синяя is the feminine form and does not match a neuter noun. Soft stems use -ее where hard stems use -ое.

errorCorrection.sentence: Это ранний утро, ещё все в нашем доме спят.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: It's early morning; everyone in our house is still asleep.
errorCorrection.explanation: Утро is neuter (-о ending), so the soft-stem adjective takes the neuter -ее: раннее. The double -е in раннее (stem ранн- + -ее) is the visual signature of a neuter soft-stem ending.

minimalPairs.explanation: Песня is feminine singular (-я). The soft-stem feminine ending is -яя: последняя. Последний would require a masculine noun like последний урок or последний день.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: There are early flowers in the garden.
minimalPairs.explanation: Цветы is plural. The soft-stem plural ending is -ие: ранние. Ранний is the masculine singular and would require one specific masculine flower (ранний цветок).

reviewVocab.definition: soft stem (the class of adjectives whose dictionary form ends in -ний; uses the four soft endings -ий, -яя, -ее, -ие)
reviewVocab.example: Прилагательное 'синий' имеет мягкую основу: формы — синий, синяя, синее, синие.

reviewVocab.definition: ending pair (the parallel hard / soft ending pair: -ый and -ий, -ая and -яя, -ое and -ее, -ые and -ие)
reviewVocab.example: Пара окончаний 'ое — ее' показывает: 'красивое окно' и 'синее окно' стоят в одной форме, только основа у этих прилагательных разная.

reviewVocab.definition: soft ending (an adjective ending spelled with the soft vowels: -ий, -яя, -ее, -ие)
reviewVocab.example: В слове 'последняя' мягкое окончание -яя показывает женский род единственного числа.
